moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.why: Musk’s repost of Rep. Ansari’s AI‑regulation post ignited a fresh sell‑off in AI and data‑center stocks, amplifying policy fear in markets.

moments.author: Yassamin Ansari
moments.quote: AI is out of control; pause advanced AI, regulate it, ban artificial superintelligence
moments.why: Her post triggered a massive market reaction and was quoted by Musk, spurring widespread concerns over AI regulation.

moments.author: JD Vance
moments.quote: The reason we lost is the war
moments.why: His blunt post blaming Republican midterm losses on Iran conflict went viral among political and policy‑focused men 25‑45.

moments.author: Russell Brand
moments.quote: [Convicted of rape and sexual assault—serial offenses]
moments.why: The conviction of a high‑profile comedian shocked social media and drove intense conversation among men reacting to justice and celebrity downfall.
